en.title: Gear user guide
en.description: Use Gear through the Python SDK or Refine Skill. Choose a complete algorithm, customize capability modules, define task rewards and inspect durable execution and recovery.

zh-CN.title: Gear 用户指南
zh-CN.description: 通过 Python SDK 或 Refine Skill 使用 Gear：选择完整算法、定制能力模块、定义任务奖励，并检查持久执行与恢复。

en.title: Quick start
en.description: Install matching Gear CLI and Python SDK builds, prepare a Target and benchmark, configure execution profiles and budgets, then plan and run an algorithm.

zh-CN.title: 快速开始
zh-CN.description: 安装同版本 Gear CLI 与 Python SDK，准备 Target 和 benchmark，配置执行 profile 与预算，再预览和运行算法。

en.title: Choose and run an algorithm
en.description: Run GEPA, RandomSearch, OPRO, ACE, RRSI, DarwinX or Harness2 through the Python SDK. Compare feedback requirements, replaceable components and the scope of real-model validation.

zh-CN.title: 选择和运行算法
zh-CN.description: 通过 Python SDK 调用 GEPA、RandomSearch、OPRO、ACE、RRSI、DarwinX 或 Harness2，了解反馈要求、可替换组件与真实模型验证范围。

en.title: Example 1: evolve a harness for Marketing
en.description: Use Gear to improve an agent's Harness from real failure evidence. Five rounds raised Luna medium's strict pass rate from 27% to 36% on the public Marketing research set; the retained Harness later scored 50% with Luna max.

zh-CN.title: 案例一：优化 Marketing Harness
zh-CN.description: 使用 Gear 根据真实失败证据改进 Agent Harness。五轮迭代中，Luna medium 在 Marketing 公开研究集上的严格通过率从 27% 提升到 36%；最终保留 Harness 后续以 Luna max 评测达到 50%。

en.title: Customize an algorithm in Python
en.description: Customize an algorithm by changing parameters, replacing components or composing operators. Use reusable parents, sampling, proposal, ranking, stopping and workflow capabilities from gear.search.

zh-CN.title: 用 Python 修改算法
zh-CN.description: 从修改参数、替换组件到组合算子，逐步定制算法；复用 gear.search 中的父代、采样、提案、排名、停止和编排能力。

en.title: Skill and Meta integration
en.description: Distinguish the operator assistant, Python algorithm, Meta and Target. Codex Meta execution uses Hitch for isolation, model requests, budget enforcement and durable receipts.

zh-CN.title: Skill 与 Meta 接入
zh-CN.description: 区分操作员助手、Python 算法、Meta 与 Target；Codex Meta 通过 Hitch 执行隔离、模型调用、预算限制和持久回执。

en.title: Prepare a Target harness
en.description: `gear init --target dsh` or `gear init --target pi` creates a native editable carrier. `target.path` points to its resource directory. Select the Target and the candidate-generating Meta profile independently.

zh-CN.title: 准备 Target Harness
zh-CN.description: `gear init --target dsh` 或 `gear init --target pi` 生成原生可编辑载体；项目中的 `target.path` 指向其资源目录。Target 与执行候选生成的 Meta profile 分别选择。

en.title: Tasks and scoring
en.description: Define task rewards in the benchmark and scorer, then configure aggregation and candidate comparison separately. Import tasks, check scoring contracts and probe execution.

zh-CN.title: 任务与评分
zh-CN.description: 在 benchmark 和评分器中定义任务奖励，单独配置聚合与候选比较；导入任务、检查评分合同并试跑。

en.title: Runs and recovery
en.description: Resume interrupted work, retry an eligible settled read-only Meta failure and explicitly amend cumulative Meta limits while preserving completed outputs, learning and usage.

zh-CN.title: 运行与恢复
zh-CN.description: 恢复中断工作，重试符合条件的已结算只读 Meta 失败，并显式调整累计 Meta 额度，保留已有输出、学习结果和消耗。

en.title: Read a report
en.description: Inspect candidate selection, learning-library outputs, task-stream progress, evaluation evidence and cumulative usage. Distinguish completed execution from a successful algorithm outcome.

zh-CN.title: 阅读报告
zh-CN.description: 查看候选选择、学习库产物、任务流进度、评测证据与累计用量，区分运行结束和算法成功。

en.title: Configuration reference
en.description: `gear init` creates project files. Named profiles contain execution settings; credentials stay in the provider's supported authentication location. Example `gear.yaml`:

zh-CN.title: 配置参考
zh-CN.description: `gear init` 生成项目文件；执行配置在命名 profile 中，凭据保留在 provider 支持的认证位置。 项目 `gear.yaml` 示例：

en.title: Troubleshooting
en.description: Save the run ID and call `gear report RUN_ID --json` first. Do not edit journals, delete ownership locks or replace sealed files to bypass recovery checks.

zh-CN.title: 问题排查
zh-CN.description: 先保存 run ID 并执行 `gear report RUN_ID --json`。不要通过改 journal、删除锁或替换封存文件绕过恢复校验。

en.title: Model training · experimental
en.description: Gear also coordinates Slime GRPO model updates while freezing the Harness and datasets. This is a separate experiment lifecycle from Harness evolution.

zh-CN.title: 模型训练 · 实验性
zh-CN.description: Gear 也可在固定 Harness 和数据集的条件下协调 Slime GRPO 模型更新。它使用独立于 Harness 进化的实验生命周期。
